signal: Agora reported Q1 2026 revenue up 13.5% to $37.7M, its sixth straight profitable quarter, and launched Agent Studio, a no-code platform for voice AI agents.

email.body1:
John, saw Agora posted 13.5% revenue growth in Q1 and launched Agent Studio for building voice AI agents.

A new platform plus that growth usually puts more accounts in play than the BD team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Agora off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Agora.

A new product line like Agent Studio expands the addressable map, but most BD teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to capture it. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your BD team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Agora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Agora's reply rate likely compares to other developer-API vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching a new platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a developer-API motion? I'll tailor it to Agora either way.
